builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21: the players' own recruiting pages (profiles[]), one entry per boys basketball registry team. Hudl's public team rosters for every school's boys basketball teams, a SportsRecruits profile-address probe and MaxPreps' claimed career pages, read by separate passes and assembled with a second read; rows whose MaxPreps grade is last season's carry a grade conflict. No roster value is enriched by hand.
notes: profiles[] only: the players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of field hockey's file (lib/players/rosters-schema.ts PlayerProfileSchema): the page names the player and a sport, and either names the school or shows the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area. A basketball profile names no sport; a profile in another sport does. No grade, height, number, position or coach is added by hand, and no school athletics site was swept. Scouting and recruiting-news pages (Prep Hoops, Prep Redzone, On3) are not profiles and are never linked here.

Linked: 731 pages for 553 varsity players (13 SportsRecruits, 467 Hudl, 251 claimed MaxPreps); in a sport other than basketball: 1 football, 3 baseball, 1 lacrosse, 1 water polo. JV players' pages are in data/basketball/jv-profiles.json.

2026-11-21, Hudl: the 58 schools with a MaxPreps basketball roster were looked up on Hudl (57 found; Westmoor not found; Homestead, Cupertino and El Camino show no boys basketball team; Monta Vista, Mt. Pleasant and Yerba Buena only empty rosters). 272 team-season rosters of 139 boys basketball teams (7,641 member rows) were matched by name, then each public profile page read. Kept when the page's own team list has a boys basketball team of the player's school and its class year, when shown, is the roster's (a nickname or other spelling only when school and class year both agree; the note says so). 67 matched rows have only private profiles; four pages redirect to Hudl's fan site and could not be read. Every kept page was read twice in separate runs that agree.

2026-11-21, MaxPreps: every varsity row's career page read twice for MaxPreps' own claimed flag (772 of 782; Burlingame's 10 career addresses lead to MaxPreps' 'Inactive Careers' notice and were not read); a claimed page is linked as a MaxPreps profile (always the row's own careerUrl).

2026-11-21, SportsRecruits: a profile-address probe in every sport for all 1,061 varsity and JV rows (both winter builds together: 10,736 addresses, 1,676 live pages, each read through the JSON the page itself loads; kept pages read four times). Most live pages show at most a class year and are not linked; 576 basketball-row matches state a class year that disagrees.
NCSA: the 2026-11-21 pass had not finished when this file was assembled; no NCSA page is linked yet.

Grades that are last season's: MaxPreps' 2026-27 rosters at several schools still carry the 2025-26 grades (a page naming the school puts the player a class ahead; Archbishop Mitty's roster, for one, has no senior). Where a page that names the right school (Hudl: the profile's own team list has the school's boys basketball team; a scouting page: its school link is the school's own page in the right city) states a class exactly one year earlier than the roster's, the row carries one grade conflict marked rosterBehind, citing the strongest such page (the player's own profile first), and the pages and ties stating either class are linked. 107 varsity rows at 22 schools carry one (Archbishop Mitty High School 17, Palo Alto High School 15, St. Ignatius College Preparatory 8, Sacred Heart Prep 8, Aptos High School 8, Woodside Priory School 7, Junípero Serra High School 6, Crystal Springs Uplands School 6, Aragon High School 6, Lincoln High School 5, Milpitas High School 3, Leigh High School 3, Scotts Valley High School 3, Santa Clara High School 2, Branham High School 2, San Lorenzo Valley High School 2, MacDonald High School 1, Ann Sobrato High School 1, Valley Christian High School 1, The King’s Academy 1, Woodside High School 1, Mills High School 1); the roster keeps MaxPreps' grade. Each page let in this way was re-read at assembly. Never for a JV row, a two-year gap, a page a year later, or a roster grade 12.

Second read at assembly (a script separate from the passes'): every page let in by a grade conflict, all SportsRecruits pages linked, and a random 40 of the kept varsity Hudl pages (10% or more) were fetched again; all confirmed.
